service_orders_item_key.name: service_orders_item_key
service_orders_item_key.where: "service_orders"."item_id" is not null and "service_orders"."deleted_at" is null

service_orders_dates.name: service_orders_dates
service_orders_dates.value: "service_orders"."issued_at" is null or "service_orders"."requested_at" is null or "service_orders"."issued_at" >= "service_orders"."requested_at"

holidays_locality.name: holidays_locality
holidays_locality.value: ("holidays"."scope" <> 'state' or "holidays"."state_code" is not null) and ("holidays"."scope" <> 'municipal' or "holidays"."city_ibge_code" is not null)

programs_dates.name: programs_dates
programs_dates.value: "programs"."end_date" is null or "programs"."start_date" is null or "programs"."end_date" >= "programs"."start_date"

time_entries_interval.name: time_entries_interval
time_entries_interval.value: "time_entries"."ended_at" is null or "time_entries"."started_at" is null or "time_entries"."ended_at" > "time_entries"."started_at"

boards_dates.name: boards_dates
boards_dates.value: "boards"."end_date" is null or "boards"."start_date" is null or "boards"."end_date" >= "boards"."start_date"

items_board_group_position_idx.name: items_board_group_position_idx
items_board_group_position_idx.where: "items"."archived_at" is null and "items"."deleted_at" is null and "items"."parent_item_id" is null

items_parent_position_idx.name: items_parent_position_idx
items_parent_position_idx.where: "items"."parent_item_id" is not null and "items"."deleted_at" is null

items_board_archived_idx.name: items_board_archived_idx
items_board_archived_idx.where: "items"."archived_at" is not null and "items"."deleted_at" is null

items_planned_dates.name: items_planned_dates
items_planned_dates.value: "items"."planned_end_date" is null or "items"."planned_start_date" is null or "items"."planned_end_date" >= "items"."planned_start_date"

items_replanned_dates.name: items_replanned_dates
items_replanned_dates.value: "items"."replanned_end_date" is null or "items"."replanned_start_date" is null or "items"."replanned_end_date" >= "items"."replanned_start_date"

items_actual_dates.name: items_actual_dates
items_actual_dates.value: "items"."actual_end_date" is null or "items"."actual_start_date" is null or "items"."actual_end_date" >= "items"."actual_start_date"

views_board_default_key.name: views_board_default_key
views_board_default_key.where: "views"."is_default" and "views"."owner_id" is null and "views"."deleted_at" is null
